dispositions.subject: the download/verify instruction turned a fully verified-looking success into a success that never hash-checked the wheel
dispositions.basis: fresh: 5/5 cases PASS -- wheel-only filter on the REAL published SHA256SUMS + REAL wheel bytes exits 0; the legacy whole-file run still exits 1 with 'FAILED open or read' (the reaudit's own counterexample, preserved); recomputed wheel digest equals the published literal d6c3e295...

dispositions.subject: duplicate axes were silently accepted and could inflate a profile
dispositions.basis: fresh: 8/8 PASS -- ['intent']*4, non-string axes, empty and unknown axes all yield typed refusals; the legal LITE/STANDARD/ASSURED triad still passes

dispositions.subject: a nine-axis category set is not a twelve-axis calibrated risk score; an unassessed profile could read as risk-safe
dispositions.basis: fresh: 1/1 PASS -- with no risk evidence the record carries risk_assessment=NOT_ASSESSED and LOW_RISK_VERIFIED is never emitted

dispositions.subject: identity and PI trace fields were untyped {}, so a wrongly typed value was accepted
dispositions.basis: fresh: 6/6 PASS -- subject_id as int/null, empty, wrong hash length and a malformed PI trace are each refused; legal CE regression intact

dispositions.subject: the documented compiler walk-through is not runnable; it is a block of placeholders
dispositions.basis: was the only genuinely open documentation delta; the front page now points at examples/first-run/ and every printed command was executed (see the lane receipt and the orchestrator re-run)

dispositions.subject: a web mount pack existed but native skill eligibility and manual fallback were not separated as capabilities
dispositions.basis: fresh: 3/3 PASS -- the mount ZIP extracts, its MANIFEST.sha256 verifies, and the documented files are present; native load stays NOT_RUN (no eligible UI in this environment), which the pack itself declares

dispositions.subject: R7 scoped PASS and R8 overall FAIL are both on record for different subjects
dispositions.basis: not re-litigated; no cross-subject addition of R7 successes into a FULL_PASS claim

dispositions.subject: the 57-row crosswalk carries EVIDENCE_GAP rows and one stale rolling-ledger row
dispositions.basis: no 57/57 all-green claim is made; only affected rows were touched and DEL-018 is marked 'different subject'

dispositions.subject: the .1/.2 preview artefacts share the 0.1.0 distribution basename while differing in bytes
dispositions.basis: stated on the front page with PEP 440 guidance; no new version was issued and none is claimed as upgradable

dispositions.subject: no pinned external source map and no replayable self-bootstrap
dispositions.basis: fresh: 1/1 PASS -- the source map is present as a derived view and the self-bootstrap replays to the same digest; the 16 MB skeleton is not imported

dispositions.subject: S5+ live receivers / unused providers
dispositions.basis: listed OFF; no activation is asserted

dispositions.subject: no real published-wheel download and no native reviewer bundle in the reviewing environment
dispositions.basis: carried as an open item with an owner and a trigger rather than rounded up

dispositions.subject: found during reconciliation: ProfileBinding's profile/axes/vetoes/artifact_depth/assurance were still {} and accepted a string, a list with a non-string, and an integer
dispositions.basis: source locator schemas/ProfileBinding.schema.json; 4 executed counterexamples all accepted before the patch; inside the admitted write-set because the duplicate-axes decision is evidenced in this record type; DISCLOSED as an addition beyond the reaudit's literal wording
